title: HAAY TANHA HAIN HUSSAIN IBNE ALI MAQTAL ME
body:
Chaand Zehra ka hai aur khoonke baadal chhaaye
Dopahar badhgayi badne lage kaale saaye
Ghir gaye Zainabe Dilgeer Tere Maajaaye
<<MINI>>
Hasrate daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dile Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehte hain Shah ke Main zulmo sitam sehta hu'n
Koi Ghamkhwar nahi'n ranjo alam sehta hu'n
Waar sehta hu'n'Main tanhayi ka Gham sehta hu'n
<<MINI>>
Hasrate daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dile Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Mera Baazu Mera Abbase Dilawar bhi nahi'n
Dil ki himmat MeraBeta Ali Akbar bhi nahi'n
Rann me Qasim bhi nahi'n jhoole me Asghar bhi nahi'n
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghar the jitne Mere armaan ke barbaad huve
Kitne Nasir the Mere ab to bas ek yaad huve
Ab koi saath nahi'n khuld me aabaad huve
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Hosla Mera badhaane ke wo manzar na rahe
Wo Muhafiz Mere Sheraane Dilawar na rahe
Mere Ansaar Mere Nasiro Yaawar na rahe
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi Mujhko hai pyaari na hai jeena Mujhko
Raas ab ho nahi'n sakta ye qareena Mujhko
Baar lagta hai ye zakhmo bhara seena Mujhko
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad marne ke Mere aur hazeena hogi
Be aba Dukhtare Sultane Madina hogi
Shimr ka hoga sitam Meri Sakina hogi
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Be sahara huve pardes me sab Aale Aba
Ghash me bhi hai Labe Sajjad pa bas aaho buka
Karti hai girya o Zaari Meri Zainab Dukhia
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Paas Mere koi damm me Meri Maa Aaegi
Khud bhi faryaad Karegi Mujhe tadpaaegi
Saath har Gham se chhudha kar Mujhe Le Jaaegi
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
<<DIVIDER>>
Gham e Shabbir ko bas yaad karo har Ghamme
Koi Gham Usse bada tonahi'n is Aalam me
Zindagi sarf ho Jaweed isi Maatam me
<<MINI>>
Hasrat e daagh ka toofaa'n hai Dil e Bekal me
Haay Tanha hain Hussain Ibne Ali maqtal me
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
